rows.note: Use 波 for a sports ball, or for the ball game or match itself, rather than a general spherical object.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 tek3 bo1

rows.note: 球 is the all-purpose noun for a spherical object, including a sports ball when the sporting context is not being emphasized.

example.jyutping: nei1 go3 kau4 taai3 hing1 laa3

rows.note: Use 廢話 when ball means nonsense or bullshit, especially in an informal dismissal.
Use 舞會 for an organized formal dance, not simply any enjoyable occasion.

example.english: The school has a ball next week.
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jau5 mou5 wui2
